description:
Per4mance Guru is an AI\-first performance marketing agency based in Delhi. We run paid media for D2C brands, B2B companies, and lead gen businesses across India, UAE, and the US. We're obsessed with outcomes — not just impressions — and we use AI tools to think sharper and move faster. We're looking for a sharp media buyer who can own campaigns, not just execute them.
 



 What you'll do
 



 Run and optimize paid campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, and LinkedIn — primarily for lead generation clients
 



 Build and test audience strategies, ad structures, and bidding setups from scratch
 



 Analyse performance data and translate it into clear actions — not just observations
 



 Collaborate with the creative team to brief and test ad concepts, especially on Meta
 



 Manage client\-level reporting — know your numbers cold, own the narrative
 



 Work across multiple client accounts simultaneously — staying organized and accountable
 



 What we're looking for
 



 1–3 years of hands\-on experience running paid campaigns (agency or in\-house, both work)
 



 Solid understanding of Meta Ads Manager — campaign structure, targeting, creative testing, and attribution
 



 Working knowledge of Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube) and LinkedIn Campaign Manager
 



 Experience with lead generation campaigns — you understand CPL, lead quality, and funnel thinking
 



 Comfortable with GA4 and basic pixel/event tracking setup
 



 Strong with data — you can read a dashboard and know what to do next
 



 Clear communicator — written and verbal
